records.observation: Stores InfoType reference and Object value. Default null/null, type-only null value, type/value constructor assigns without consistency validation. Unknown nonnull type throws IOException; null type dereferenced before that branch. BYTE4/BYTE8 share integer IO, display as Integer/Long.toHexString; STR returns string, others value.toString or null. writeObject writes one-byte type then value; readObject constructs InfoType from input then reads value; input constructor delegates default and readObject.
